title: Helyszinrajz Drawing Spec
description: Shared contract for a Hungarian electrical connection site plan (helyszinrajz). The AI service emits a document conforming to this schema; the AutoCAD Map 3D 2026 plugin consumes it to render editable geometry. Scale is fixed at 1:500 and 1 drawing unit = 1 meter.

meta.description: Document metadata about generation and provenance.

schema_version.description: Verzioszam: version of this drawing-spec contract the document targets.

generator.description: Eloallito: name/identifier of the tool or model that produced the spec.

confidence_note.description: Megbizhatosagi megjegyzes: statement that a human engineer confirms survey-accurate placement before issue; the AI output is a draft proposal only.

project.description: Projekt adatok: core identifying data for the drawing and its parties.

subject.description: Targ: the subject/title of the project (address, hrsz., and purpose).

scale_denominator.description: Meretarany nevezoje: scale denominator. Fixed at 500 (i.e. 1:500).

raster.description: Raszter alaterkep: the e-kozmu (e-utility) base map PDF/image reference and attach info. Raster only, no vector geometry.

file.description: Fajl hivatkozas: path or name of the base map PDF/image file.

attach.description: Beillesztesi informacio: how the raster is attached/positioned in model space.

insertion_point.description: Beillesztesi pont: insertion point in the raster image/paper coordinate space (the same space the georeference points map to model meters). The plugin runs this point through the georeference transform to place the raster; it is NOT a model-meter coordinate. Use the raster's own origin (typically 0,0) unless the base map is cropped.

scale_denominator.description: Beillesztesi meretarany: scale denominator for the attach, 500 for 1:500.

rotation_deg.description: Elforgatas (fok): rotation of the attached raster in degrees.

georeference.description: Georeferencia: EXACTLY 2 reference points mapping image/paper coordinates to model coordinates in meters. Two points fix translation, rotation, and uniform scale so that 1 drawing unit = 1 meter.

layers.description: Retegek: array of layer keys used by the drawing. Each key should resolve to an entry in symbols.config.json layer definitions or be a plain layer name.

items.description: Reteg kulcs vagy nev: layer key or name.

symbols.description: Jelek: placed symbol instances (e.g. tervezett fogyasztasmero szekreny).

cable_runs.description: Kabel nyomvonalak: polyline runs such as the planned connection cable or the kutatoarok (exploratory trench). Vertices are in model meters.

labels.description: Feliratok: free text annotations placed in model space.

legend.description: Jelmagyarazat: ordered legend entries pairing a symbol_key with its explanatory text.

title_block.description: Fejlec / rajzpecset: key/value map of title-block field values. Keys correspond to tags defined in titleblock.config.json.

summary.description: Osszegzes: summary fields shown near the title block.

erintett_kozterulet.description: Erintett kozterulet: affected public land / public area description.

kabel_teljes_hossza_m.description: Kabel teljes hossza (m): total cable length in meters.

point.description: Pont: a 2D point. Interpreted in model meters unless stated otherwise.

vertex.description: Toreespont: a polyline vertex in model meters.

georeference_point.description: Georeferencia pont: a correspondence between an image/paper coordinate and a model coordinate in meters.

image.description: Kep/papir koordinata: point in paper/image units.

model.description: Modell koordinata: corresponding point in model meters.

units.description: Mertekegyseg: model units. Must be 'meter' so that 1 drawing unit = 1 meter.

note.description: Megjegyzes: derived note, e.g. that 1 drawing unit = 1 meter.

symbol_instance.description: Jel peldany: a placed symbol instance referencing a symbol_key from symbols.config.json.

position.description: Pozicio: placement point in model meters.

label.description: Felirat: optional label text for this symbol.

cable_run.description: Kabel nyomvonal: a polyline run with vertices in model meters.

symbol_key.description: Jel/stilus kulcs: symbol or style key into symbols.config.json for layer/color/linetype.

vertices.description: Toreespontok: ordered polyline vertices in model meters.

length_m.description: Hossz (m): run length in meters, optional and computable from vertices.

cable_type.description: Kabel tipus: cable type, e.g. '4x35mm2 NAYY-J'.

label.description: Felirat: a free text annotation in model space.

position.description: Pozicio: placement point in model meters.

height_m.description: Szovegmagassag (m): text height in model meters.

legend_entry.description: Jelmagyarazat tetel: a single legend entry.

text.description: Magyarazat: explanatory text for the symbol.

bom_row.description: Anyagjegyzek sor: a bill of materials row.
